featured_reviews.review_text:
We’ve been loyal fans of Roongmit since their roadside cart days, and finally visiting their newly opened restaurant felt like watching a favorite story level up and they’ve absolutely nailed it.

Every dish brought back that same authentic flavor we loved, just elevated with a better experience and presentation.

The Alaska Roll Sushi and Prawns Tempura Sushi were fresh, perfectly balanced, and packed with flavor. The Tokyo-style Karaage Chicken Bao was soft, juicy, and downright addictive. The Avocado Poke Bowl felt wholesome yet indulgent, while the Spicy Chicken Ramen delivered that comforting, rich kick you crave.

From humble beginnings to a beautifully done space, Roongmit has kept its soul intact and that’s what makes it special.

A must-visit for anyone who loves great Asian food with a story.

featured_reviews.name: Praneet Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited the Rongmit stall in Versova to try their ramen bowl menu. Howevr, we were informed dat ramen was not available that day. Not sure about the exact reason, maybe a gas cylinder issue or something else.

So we decided to order Chicken Sidu instead. The staff informed us that it would take some time to prepare, which we agreed to nd waited for around 15 to 20 mins.
Wen it was served, it looked very tempting nd the filling seemed quite generous. But when we tried to lift it, we noticed that the chicken inside appeared pinkish,hinting its undercooked. Since it was our first time trying Sidu, we were not sure whether it was supposed to be served that way.

The moment we took a bite, we immediately sensed a strong foul smell. The chicken was clearly raw and chewy. To be completely sure, we took another small bite or two and confirmed that it was indeed undercooked.

We quietly discarded the food without complaining to the staff or the owner, as we did not want to create a scene or disturb the experience of others there. We paid the bill and left.

Not planning to visit again anytime soon. But if we ever do, we might try their momos and will definitely request them to ensure the food is cooked properly before serving.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was in the mood for chicken and rice, and I was recommended Ohio by one of my friends, and I absolutely loved all of the dishes I ordered! My order:

🍲🍱Chicken Katsu with red Thai curry and jasmine rice: The lemongrass flavour of Thai curry is what makes it one of my favourite dishes! the Japanese katsu style chicken was absolutely delicious, it felt very on point in recreating the original katsu flavour; and the jasmine rice paired perfectly with both the katsu and the curry, making for a perfect meal. This dish is a complete set for one, and it sufficient for satiating both the stomach and the heart :)

🍛🥡Texas style barbeque chicken with burnt garlic rice: Two things I love coming together: bbq and garlic, this dish was amazing, the bbq sauce was so good and paired well with the garlic rice

This was hands down the highlight of my order, the chicken was so flavourful and plenty, it was not just the skin that held the flavour, but the meat was so juicy and oozing flavour, absolutely would recommend this to everyone!
Loved the protective and sanitary packaging, and how they took care of cooking instructions, must try!

featured_reviews.name: Monica
featured_reviews.review_text:
We just found one of the most exciting Korean street food spots in Mumbai, and honestly, it feels like something straight out of South Korea, all for under ₹300.

From crispy corndogs and Korean ramen to bingsu ice cream and unique boba drinks, this place checks every box for anyone who loves K-drama food or Korean flavours.

The Crunchy Ramyeon Corn Dog is a must-try, and the creamy, spicy ramen is comforting with just the right kick. For something refreshing, the Taro Matcha drink works perfectly as a quick, flavourful sip on the go.

Their Yangnyeom Chicken Popcorn : Korean fried chicken tossed in a sweet and spicy sauce is seriously addictive. And to end on a sweet note, the Mango Wave Bingsu turns creamy mango milk into a light, fluffy, super indulgent dessert.

This is Oppa, a newly opened Korean spot just a 5-minute walk from Versova Beach, and once you try it, it’s definitely going to be a regular on your food list.

Visited this small Korean restaurant in Mumbai and had a pleasant experience overall. The ramen noodles leaned a bit on the sweeter side, and the bibimbap bowl, while not very authentic, was still quite enjoyable in its own way.

What really stood out was the friendly owner, along with the clean and hygienic setup, which instantly makes you feel comfortable. The place has a simple, warm vibe and is good for a relaxed meal.

Definitely recommended if you’re open to slightly adapted Korean flavours and value hospitality and cleanliness.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Oppa Korean Street Food in Versova and really liked the vibe. It’s a small, casual place, perfect for quick bites rather than a long sit-down meal.

Tried their corn dogs and some drinks and ice-creams. The sauces were well balanced and not overly spicy, which works well for Indian taste buds.

Prices are reasonable for the quality and portion size, and the location is easy to find. Seating is limited, so it can feel a bit crowded during peak hours, but that’s expected for a street-food style outlet.

Overall, a fun spot for Korean snacks and drinks in Andheri West, worth visiting if you’re craving Korean street food without spending too much.

Great spot for casual, tasty Korean bites!

featured_reviews.name: Dharm Saraswat
featured_reviews.review_text: I absolutely loved the place, the vibrant atmosphere was electric! The ambiance felt beautiful, and the food was outstanding. After days of mediocre meals, I finally savored something truly tasty and unique. featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this restaurant and had quite an enjoyable experience. The restaurant has a cozy vibe, and the staff were welcoming and attentive, which made the overall dining experience even better.

We ordered a mix of starters and mains, and the variety on the menu was impressive. We started with the Wtf! Fries, Masala Onion Rings, and Chicken Popcorn. The fries were crispy, and the masala on the onion rings gave them a nice kick. The chicken popcorn was delicious—bite-sized, crispy, and perfect to munch on.

The Bucket Chicken Wings and Nachos were also great. The wings were well-cooked with just the right amount of spice, and the nachos were loaded with cheese and toppings, making them a good option for sharing.

For the mains, we tried the Railway Chicken Curry, Butter Chicken, and Kotigara Kheema Rice. The Railway Chicken Curry had a rich, traditional flavor, which I really enjoyed. The Butter Chicken was creamy and flavorful, exactly how it should be. The Kotigara Kheema Rice was a nice touch to round off the meal—it was hearty and full of flavor.

We also had Long Island Iced Tea, which was strong and refreshing. The drinks were slightly on the expensive side, but they were well-made and definitely added to the experience.

The service was good throughout. Threy have a bell service where you have to press the bell and the waiter will come to attend your table. The staff were quick to take orders, and the food arrived promptly. I also appreciated the presentation of the dishes—it showed they took care in making everything look appetizing.

The quality of food, drinks, and service was appreciate. If you're in Versova and want to try some tasty dishes with a mix of cocktails, The WTF is definitely worth a visit!

featured_reviews.name: Chef Vaidehi Pathare
featured_reviews.review_text:
On a windy evening, I visited Darjeeling Lepcha Momo Outlet near Versova Beach. The outlet was crowded when I arrived, but we got seated within minutes. It is a small non AC setup with about 8 tables, so it can feel a bit packed during peak hours.

I tried the Chicken Hariyali Tandoori Momo and Chicken Peri Peri Momo. The Hariyali Momo was prepared in the tandoor, which gave it a subtle smoky. The green chutney served alongside complemented it nicely. The Chicken Peri Peri Momo was fried and slightly oily on the outside. The peri peri coating was flavourful and evenly spiced, however the actual stuffing lacked the flavor and texture. It could have been more succulent and better seasoned to create a more balanced bite. I feel a well made Momo is flavourful from within, not just coated well on the outside.

Overall, I would say it was a decent visit. Service was good and timely.

Ratings:
Quality – 3.5/5
Quantity – 3.7/5
Service – 3.5/5
Price – ₹400 for 2 people

For more mouthwatering food content, don’t forget to follow @chefvaidehipathare on Instagram!

Recently, we visited Darjeeling Lepcha Momos restaurant, where we ordered Chicken Peri Peri Deep-Fried Momos, Chicken Tandoori Momos, and Chicken Thukpa Soup.

The Tandoori Momos were absolutely delicious — flavorful and perfectly cooked. The Peri Peri Momos were good too, but they had a bit too much Peri Peri masala, which made them overly spicy and affected the overall taste.

However, the real surprise was the Chicken Thukpa Soup — it was mind-blowingly good! We had ordered just one bowl to try it out, and it turned out to be the best decision. The soup was rich, loaded with ingredients, and had a unique taste that set it apart from regular Chinese soups.

Highly recommend trying the Thukpa Soup — it’s a must-have! The food here is also halal (we confirmed this with the waiter). Overall, it was a really good experience, and we’ll definitely visit again — especially for that amazing Thukpa Soup.

All in all, if you’re looking for a place to sweat, squirm, and solve menu puzzles — this is your spot. Otherwise, you might want to explore literally anywhere else.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Soneji
featured_reviews.review_text:
Deewano da Dhaba or as they call it here, D3 is a place I came across on Zomato. We needed a place for a get together with old friends so decided to visit here as it has pure North Indian Cuisine.

It's located really on the other side of Versova, you have to reach by Google Maps only.

They have NonAc Section outside and the setup is completely Dhaba style with Khatiyas. Inside is Ac section with around 6 tables which has normal restaurant type seating.

I ordered Masala Chaas for myself. Very refreshing, the curd was very fresh.

APPETIZERS

Bharwan Tandoori Aloo :

The most famous dish of theirs in the vegetarian section was their Tandoori Bharwan Aloo so I ordered this as potato is my anytime favorite. The Potato was stuffed with paneer and cheese, and was cooked in tandoor. It was just so delicious.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Badami Paneer Tikka :

A first time for me, I tried Badami Paneer because my friend ordered it. A lovely almond flavor came as the aftertaste, and they had slivers of almond as garnish too. The paneer was soft and fresh. Loved it.

Paneer Angara Tikka :

Another one of their specialities, Paneer Angara Tikka is their spicy version of the regular paneer tikka. The paneer was really soft and very fresh.

D3 Special Murgh Angara Tikka :

For the chicken, we chose the speciality again. Chicken Tikka was served on a sizzler platter with sizzling fire. The chicken was cooked well, loved the smoky taste and it was spicy too.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

MAIN COURSE

Murgh Lababdar :

Chicken tikka pieces cookes in creamy tomato gravy, along with cheese. I had never tried this dish and I must say, I was too overjoyed. This was just amazing. The tikka pieces still had their tandoori taste, the gravy was deliciously cheesy and creamy. I had it with roomali roti and liked it though i think tandoori roti would have gone better.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Dal Makhani :

North Indian restaurant and I dont have Dal Makhani, that's not possible. Dal Makhani is my favorite lately and I ordered this along with Steam Rice. It was sooo yummy. The dal was cooked so well, the amount of creaminess was just perfect. I had with roti as well as rice.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

DESSERT

Jalebi Rabdi :

The best Jalebi n Rabdi I have had in recent times. The jalebi was freshly fried in desi ghee and was very crispy. Not too sweet, which was better.
The rabdi was thick and too creamy n tasty, we just couldn't stop eating it.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Their delivery radius is around 6-7kms which is more than the other restaurants deliver too, which is a really good thing.

The servers are all happy go lucky and always smiling and readily help with choosing the dishes. Even the owner is a very sweet and down to earth person.

The service is a tad bit slow but only because they have a lot of orders flowing through for delivery and also coz the place was getting full by the night. The crowd really pulled up after 9pm. Food is really value for money. Worth a visit..!!

I am going back for sure..!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your detailed and heartwarming review! We're delighted you enjoyed our authentic dhaba vibe and a variety of dishes like Bharwan Tandoori Aloo, Badami Paneer Tikka, and Murgh Lababdar. It’s wonderful to hear that our Jalebi Rabdi and Dal Makhani stood out for you. Your kind words about our team and service mean the world to us. We can’t wait to welcome you back for another memorable meal—hopefully with Sarson da Saag and Makki di Roti next time!

featured_reviews.name: Preetie Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m an old school and rooted person when it comes to food. I love my basics more than the fancy frilly food we get these days. Basics never go wrong and never fail in satisfying one’s palate. Deewano Daa Dhaba stole a piece of my heart the other day. I’m really surprised why there are so many negative reviews posted here when this place really deserves to be among the best ones for North Indian food. I can say this easily that this place probably serves the best quality of paneer in Mumbai.

The place is simple with Ac and non Ac sections. The outside area has the wooden cots for the desi wala feeling while enjoying your meal whereas the inside section is the regular seating. The food we ordered is as follows;

1. Nimbu Pudine ka Sherbat: This is an absolute must try . It’s super refreshing and the flavours are simply perfect. Do not miss this.
2. Bharwan Tandoori Aloo : The stuffing in these aloos was loads of soft paneer and it was a melt in the mouth kind texture. The marination was good but could have been better. The Tandoori punch was slightly missing here. But still this dish was so good.
3. Corn & Cheese seekh Kebab. Super soft & succulent kebabs. Was mild and yet so flavoursome.
4. Paneer Mussalam: An absolute must try here. U just cannot miss this dish here. It’s not just the quality of paneer that won’t my heart but how well they had prepared the gravy to match this quality of paneer is commendable.
5. Dal Makhani. What’s a Punjabi meal without this dal !!! Obviously a must try again. No words to describe my experience…. Simply order it.
6. Tandoori roti and mirchi Dhaniya kulcha. Now the reason I’m mentioning the breads here is bcos they were the regular breads but what made them super special was the liberal dollop of desi white butter served on top of these. It just made me so nostalgic and the taste of our food enhanced almost ten folds due to this. It’s a rare treat to find desi makkhan these days and when u get to relish it with a hearty meal like this then I think Nirvana is achieved 😃
7. Desi Ghee ki Jalebi with Rabdi. Omg is the list of must try not going to stop!!! A definite must try here. Simply wow effect.  The flavour of the desi ghee with the thick laccha rabdi is heavenly. Mild Sweet so the guilt is slightly lesser. 😅

While writing this review I have been salivating and craving to go back again to this place as I can’t control my cravings now. So probably my next meal maybe just here today 😅 This sums up my experience I guess. One more thing that I must mention here is the warm and friendly hospitality of The owner, Mr. Siddhesh Chawla and his wonderful staff.
They were flawless and courteous.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for such a heartfelt and detailed review! We're so glad our food and hospitality resonated with your love for the basics. Your kind words about our dishes, from the Nimbu Pudine ka Sherbat to the Paneer Mussalam and Desi Ghee Jalebi, truly mean the world to us. We’re thrilled to have earned a place in your heart and look forward to welcoming you back soon for another nostalgic and fulfilling meal!

featured_reviews.name: Komal Jaisingh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at Off Yari Road, this modern Dhaba is the place you need to go!! Serving delicious vegetarian and Non Vegetarian North Indian food, Dewano da Dhaba is living up to its name! The have AC as well as Non AC ambience.. and a great place to hangout with family and friends! The owner, Siddesh Chawla was really friendly and made sure all his guests were comfortable... The service was good and staff was courteous.. Ravi and Jagbandu served us well!!
Talking about the food we had... We had some refreshing Mocktails .. Blue eyes, Virgin Mojito, Virgin Mojito Cranberry and fresh lime soda!! Would highly recommend Blue eyes and Virgin Mojito Cranberry..
Also had some mouthwatering starters like Paneer Angara which came on a hot sizzling platter.. And had Murgh Cheese Achari Tikka which was drooling.. both these starters made our day!!
Coming to the main course.. we had Paneer Lababdar which was great in quantity and Mutton Korma which was amazing and perfect for mutton lovers!! Also would suggest The yummy Kulcha !!
Well there is always a room for desserts.. We tried the Malpura Rabdi.. I tried Malpura for the very first time and I have to say it that I really liked it.. the crispiness of Malpura and the sweet Rabdi made a superb combination together..

Overall this place is a must go to satisfy all your food cravings!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for such a glowing review! We’re thrilled you enjoyed the food, drinks, and overall experience at D3. Your recommendations, from the Blue Eyes mocktail to the sizzling Paneer Angara and Malpura Rabdi, are greatly appreciated. We’re glad our team, including Ravi and Jagbandu, made your visit special. Looking forward to welcoming you back soon for more delightful meals!

featured_reviews.name: nitin seth
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you want to try spicy north indian food then this is the place. Located in the interiors of yari road it is quite inside. Food in generally is spicy here. We started with masala papad with green chatni and that's when we realised the food is going to be hot and spicy. The green chat was so spicy that one could smell the fragrance of green chili, it had coconut as well and black pepper.
Starters we had Tandoori Chicken Lollipop,  Green Chicken Tandoori & Promfret Tawa Fry.
All 3 were delicious and perfect with the chatni.
Mutton Shorbha was the Nos. 1 dish here.  Dal Makhni was 2nd followed by Tandoori Chicken Lollipop. AC section has less tables compared to outside. Decently priced. A bit heavy & spicy but no minus cz north indian food is supposed to be like that.

It's great to hear that our chutney and starters added to your experience. We look forward to serving you again soon!
